description: Unkey provides API management and compute services for developers, including issuing and verifying API keys, rate limiting, analytics, and deploying apps behind a gateway. Its platform is organized around workspaces and root keys with scoped permissions.
summary: Unkey exposes one authenticated HTTP API at `api.unkey.com`, two authenticated hosted MCP servers at `mcp.unkey.com`, and an authenticated `unkey` CLI.
